images.prompt: Use case: product-mockup / reference-guided reconstruction. Create a high-resolution photorealistic ecommerce cutout of ONE precast reinforced concrete Olympic fence post based on the main foreground concrete post in the supplied Romboidal reference photo. The reference is low-resolution: reconstruct convincingly, do not reproduce blur. Entire post visible from flat bottom to angled upper arm; long slender square-section light gray concrete shaft with the recognizable integral bent/angled top extension for barbed wire matching the reference silhouette. Show subtle realistic fine aggregate texture and only simple small mounting holes as suggested by reference; no exposed rebar, no branding, no text or measurements. Isolate ONLY the post, remove ALL chainlink, wires, landscape, grass, sky, other posts and yellow circular border. Actual fully transparent alpha background, no simulated checkerboard, no floor or cast shadow. Premium soft neutral studio lighting; slight three-quarter view reveals two faces; centered, nearly vertical, full object occupies 88 percent of image height, generous clear margin, square canvas, highest available quality and resolution. This is a product reference illustration, not a technical dimensional drawing.
